meta.about: The player character's voice lines (barks): what each line says, its takes, what triggers it, how often, and how it sits in the mix (docs/unreal/AUDIO.md section 2). Read by FMIVoiceData (Source/MurderInc/Audio/MIVoiceRules). Everything here is data: retune chances, cooldowns and priorities, move a line to other triggers, add takes or a character's own set without touching code.
meta.placeholders: Every take marked placeholder: true is a stand-in in a generic stock synthetic voice (not the character's voice, not a clone of anyone). The real recordings replace them file for file: same folder, same file name (AUDIO.md section 5 is the recording brief). Then set placeholder to false and re-run tools/box/audio-import.sh.
meta.files: A take's file is relative to Content/Audio/Voice/<character>/. The import script makes the asset /Game/Audio/Voice/<character>/<file stem>.

triggers.about: Every trigger the system knows, derived from the event bus only (FMIVoiceTriggers). A trigger no line lists stays silent.
triggers.kill.ordinary: the player killed a Goon with a round to the body
triggers.kill.headshot: the player's killing round hit a Goon's head
triggers.kill.melee: the player killed with the melee strike
triggers.kill.explosive: a blast killed an enemy (every blast is credited to the player, spec 04 3.14)
triggers.kill.buzzard: the player brought a Buzzard down (any cause credited to him)
triggers.kill.multi: a second (or later) kill within multiKill.window seconds of the previous one
triggers.kill.streak: the streak (kills without taking streak.breakDamage in one hit and with no gap over streak.gap seconds) reached one of streak.thresholds; the payload is the threshold
triggers.kill.lastOfWave: the kill that cleared a Hold the Block wave (the kill and objective:done wave arrive in the same coalescing window)
triggers.run.start: a run starts (game:state intro, or playing straight from the title or a reset)
triggers.reel.collected: a master reel is secured (objective:done with an objective id)
triggers.objective.update: the objective line changes during play (hud:objective), not at the start of a run
triggers.wave.cleared: a Hold the Block wave is cleared (objective:done wave)
triggers.health.lowSurvived: health fell under lowHealth.below in a hit and the player was still alive lowHealth.survive seconds after the last hit
triggers.extraction.called: the last reel is secured and the truck is called (objective:all)
triggers.results.complete: the debrief card after a win (menus:card complete)
triggers.results.holdout: the Hold the Block card (menus:card dead after a Hold the Block run: that mode only ends this way)
triggers.results.dead: the death card of a Story run: listed by no line on purpose

duck.about: While a line plays every other sound category is turned down by these factors (attack, release in seconds). Voice and UI are never ducked.

frequency.about: The options' 'How often' setting: chance and cooldowns of every line are scaled; off silences the barks (story beats too).

options.about: Defaults of the voice options (FMIAudioOptions): voice volume 0..1, subtitles on or off, how often, clean language.

subtitle.about: The HUD line under the crosshair while a line plays: speaker in gold, the line in white (spec 07 brand tokens); hold = the take's length + extra.

holla.about: The common kill bark: the call-and-response chant.

murda.about: The signature: headshots, multi-kills, the last enemy of a wave.

rulebaby.about: The raspy self-hype ad-lib: progress beats (a reel, a wave, the truck called, a close call survived).

name.about: The big one: the win and long kill streaks. Answered a beat later by the crowd (line 'rule_chant').

clean.about: With clean language on: 'swap' plays the clean takes with the clean text; 'bleep' plays the normal takes with a 1 kHz tone over each take's bleep range (seconds) and the starred text.

rule_chant.speaker: CROWD
rule_chant.about: The crowd's answer. Only ever played as the answer of 'name'; never interrupted.

inc.about: Spelling out the initials: the intro (run start) and the outro (the results card).

deuce.speaker: DEUCE
deuce.about: No lines yet: the crew members of LOADOUT.md get their own sets when their voices exist. A character with no lines is silent (no fallback to Rule's voice).
